findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-602.11: The ice machine is observed with mold/build-up present on the ice machine baffle on the lower lip and on the top sealed portion inside the machine. Ensure these areas are cleaned and sanitized to remove the current build-up of debris and then cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. For the top portion of the ice machine, the existing caulking will need to be scrapped, the area cleaned and sanitized, and then a new seal placed. This was observed on the 4/25/2024 inspection report and an additional follow-up-sup is being scheduled for 5/16/2024. 
4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited
findings.comment:
A large number of German roaches are observed in all life stages throughout the facility again this morning, especially in the "hot spots" identified yesterday near the door from the dining are to the kitchen, near the ice machine at the drive thru area, around the sandwich prep area and on the food contact surfaces of the sandwich prep area, around floor drains, along floor/wall junctions throughout the kitchen and on walls and shelves. Terminix has sprayed and baited the kitchen areas, and more it is evident that some of the roaches are in the dying process; however, there are still too numerous of live juveniles throughout the kitchen. Facility will voluntarily remain closed until live roaches are no longer observed in the food prep and food storage areas. Once live roaches are no longer observed in food prep areas, facility will call SCDPH to schedule the next follow-up before re-opening.
750-1160 Effective measures to minimize the presence of rodents and insects shall be utilized. Provide effective pest control.

Multiple juveniles were observed throughout the facility. Multiple glue traps throughout the facility with many dead and alive roaches in all life stages.  Facility voluntarily closed at 11:15 am. Contact pest control operator as soon as possible. Last visit from Terminex was 9/25/14 and were scheduled to return 10/9/14.

REPEAT 2x> Observed the ceiling vents above the walk-in cooler to be soiled with an accumulation of dust. Clean vents.
750-1220 Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Shake mix in the reservoir of the shake machine was 50 degrees.  The product was discarded to CORRECT the violation.

750-120(a) Potentially hazardous foods, shall be maintained at a proper product temperature at all times during storage (41°F or below, or 135°F or above)

findings.title: Facilities to maintain proper temperatures
findings.comment:
The shake machine was keeping product at 50 degrees.  The thermostat on the machine was turned down.  By the end of this inspection, the product was 41 degrees.  Monitor the machine to be sure it always keeps shake product at 41 degrees or less.

750-140 All refrigeration units used to store potentially hazardous foods shall be able to maintain proper product temperature at 41°F or below.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
1.  The edge of the wood shelf on which personal drinks are kept by the handsink is raw wood.  Sand and paint the edge of the shelf.
2.  The wood shelf to the upper left of the ice machine is raw wood.  Sand and paint the shelf.
3. There are small gaps in the vents in the hood over the convection ovens.   Fill the gaps with a larger filter or sheet metal.
4.  The front edges of the shelves at the front counter and in the drive-up area are chipped.  Sand and paint the chipped edges or use protective metal or plastic strips to protect the shelves.   (REPEAT VIOLATION)

750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled:
  1.  wire shelf on which the radio is setting to the left of the hot box,
  2.  surfaces inside the fryer doors  (REPEAT VIOLATION)
  3.  wheels on fryers
  4.  surface behind the right hand soda nozzle on the soda machine at the drive-up window
Clean these surfaces.

750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Several stacks of food containers in the sandwich prep area were stored food side up.  The stacks were inverted to CORRECT the violation.

750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
The tops of the waste baskets in both restrooms has partial lids.  Provide lids to the waste baskets that both close all the way.

750-1110d Toilet facilities shall be kept clean and in good repair and free of objectionable odors. A supply of toilet tissue shall be provided at each toilet at all times. Easily cleanable, covered receptacles shall be provided for waste materials.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
The floor under the fryers was soiled.   Clean the floor.

750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
The ceiling vents above the walk-in cooler door were soiled.  (REPEAT VIOLATION)    Clean the vents.

750-1220 Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
750-600
(A) Replace the moldy wall-to-sink seals on the mop sink and on the 3-pan sink.
(B) Sand and paint (or use protective plastic or metal strips) the leading edges of the wood shelving under the drive-up window and under the front counter.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
750-800e
(A) Clean the bottom inside of the cabinet (inside the right door) under the fry warmer.
(B) Continue to clean the surfaces inside the doors of the fryers (REPEAT VIOLATION)

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
750-1200 and 750-1220
Clean or repair the following floors and coving:
  >>  clean the left rear corner of the walk-in cooler  (REPEAT VIOLATION)
  >>  clean the right rear corner and under the shelves in the walk-in freezer
  >>  replace the damaged coving at the right side of the door to the walk-in freezer

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
750-1220
Clean the ceiling vents above the door to the walk-in cooler.

findings.title: No Certified Manager Present
findings.comment:
There was no certified Food Service Sanitation Manager (FSSM) on duty.  Enough employees must become certified as FSSMs so that at least one is on duty during all shifts.

750-540 All Category I facilities must employ an adequate number of  Licensed Food Service Sanitation Managers to have one present at all times food is being prepared to help ensure proper food handling.  Provide an adequate number of  Food Service Sanitation Manager.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Ice cream product in the soft serve ice cream machine was 44 degrees the entire time of this inspection (about 2.5 hours).  The product was discarded to CORRECT the violation.

750-120(a) Potentially hazardous foods, shall be maintained at a proper product temperature at all times during storage (41°F or below, or 135°F or above)

findings.title: Facilities to maintain proper temperatures
findings.comment:
The soft serve ice cream machine was not able to keep product at 41 degrees or less in its reservoir.  The machine was taken out of service for repair.

750-140 All refrigeration units used to store potentially hazardous foods shall be able to maintain proper product temperature at 41°F or below.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Pans of food in the 1 door Delfield freezer and in the cooler under the sandwich prep station were not covered.  (REPEAT VIOLATION) Cover the food.

750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times.

findings.title: Foods handled with minimal manual contact
findings.comment:
An employee working the drive-up window used a customer's cup (before giving it to the customer) to fill it with ice.   Use a scoop with a handle to fill drink cups.

750-160 Ready to eat foods shall be handled in a manner to minimize direct hand contact.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
The handle on a pair of tongs was laying in the food in the 1-door Delfield freezer.  The tongs were stored so the handle was our of the food to CORRECT the violation.

750-280 Food dispensing utensils shall be stored in the food with the handle extending out of the food; or stored clean and dry; or stored in running potable water dipper wells.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
(A) The filter in the hood over the Garland convection ovens is not seated in its place.  (REPEAT VIOLATION).  Put the filter back into its place in the hood.      (B) The wall-to-sink seal on the 3-pan sink and mop sink is moldy.  Remove the moldy caulk and reseal the gap.        (C) The front edge of the wood shelves at the drive-up window and under the front counter are worn/chipped.  Sand and paint the edges.

750-600 Non-food contact surfaces shall be smooth and easily cleanable

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
There was a small amount of food on the back side of the slicer blade guard on the cabinet opposite the 3-pan sink.   Clean and sanitize the blade guard.

750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
(A)  The surfaces inside the fryer doors were soiled with grease and dust. (REPEAT VIOLATION)  Clean the surfaces.
(B)  The bottom inside of the cabinet (inside the right door) under the fry warmer was soiled.   Clean the inside of the cabinet.

750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Several stacks of cup lids and food containers were stored food side up at the sandwich prep station and at the drive-up window.    The items were inverted to CORRECT the violation.

750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: See Page 2 under "General Comments"

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
The following ceilings and walls were damaged or soiled:
(A) soiled ceiling vent above the door to the walk-in cooler
(B) soiled walls around the mop sink (the mop sink was soiled too)
(C) damaged ceiling tile and metal grid it fits in above the door to the walk-in cooler (REPEAT VIOLATION)
750-1210 and 750.1220 Clean the vent, mop sink and walls around it, replace the damaged ceiling tile, and repair the damaged ceiling grid.

findings.title: No Certified Manager Present
findings.comment:
A licensed Food Service Sanitation Manager (FSSM) was not on duty - see "General Comments" on page two for more commentary on this issue.  Have several employees become licensed as FSSMs so that every shift is covered.

750-540 All Category I facilities must employ an adequate number of  Licensed Food Service Sanitation Managers to have one present at all times food is being prepared to help ensure proper food handling.  Provide an adequate number of  Food Service Sanitation Managers.
